Canonical research core · lean

Canonical game reconstruction and blocker-count bounds

Identifies the canonical blocker-union orbit with the actual game at row n+1, including normalized diagonal output and positive blocker counts; derives quadratic and square-root count certificates.

Lean verified (stated scope)

Verification applies only to the recorded source snapshot and check scope. Consult the coverage report for build and axiom-check details.

Scientific review

Review verdict: passed. Evidence and exact scope are linked above.

Hypotheses and scope

  • The orbit starts at canonicalSeed = ([[0]],[0]), equal to canonicalQState 1. The all-row step uses forcing [0] at row 0 and [] thereafter. The square-root certificate assumes R*R <= 2*N, for natural N and R.

Formalization correspondence

sourceQueue and rowQueue normalize exact historical and current-row source values by the row cut. The scan proof identifies both outputs and survivors. canonical_step and canonicalOrbit_eq_state inductively bind that quotient to gameF. Output is gameF(n+1,n+1)-(n+1), with truncated natural subtraction; absolute target and hole-count bridges account for the index shift. The count A(N) satisfies 2*N <= A(N)^2+5*A(N)+2 and R-2 <= A(N) when R^2 <= 2*N.

Verification evidence

This corrected source snapshot passed a new clean strict build, exhaustive serialized and elaborated declaration/axiom census, and five fresh Lean kernel replays. Exact source/type correspondence and unchanged logical declarations after the documented comment corrections were checked separately. Only the standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound axioms were observed. Module and compiler-declaration counts are not counts of independent mathematical theorems.
